persistenceCoverage.scope: Observed shared-storage API traffic and end-to-end multi-segment score coverage; public data provides no independent saved-file-byte metric.

limits: Official pass uses frozen RNG and grid+cursor scoring; animation score is supplemental in the original harness.

Strict all-metric status additionally requires animation screen equality, exact per-frame animation cursor triples at every recorded boundary, exact actual output/per-step counts, zero pending animations, no forbidden capability attempts and storage traffic.

Older telemetry without animationCursors is unverified for animation cursor equality, not a cursor mismatch. Historical count-and-animation-screen passes do not establish full animation cursor coverage.
On replay error the adapter may not extract partial emitted arrays; zero telemetry output counts do not establish that the engine made no RNG calls.
